_about: M3 E3 lurch (tap-strafe) parameters. Every value is printed by lurch_analysis.py (analysis_output.txt, results.json). Sessions: M3_lurch_chain + M3_pilot (144 fps), M3_fps120 + M3_fps120_rerun (120 fps), M3_fps60 (60 fps); 102 scored e3_* trials (ok=true, warmup=false). Gibraltar, movescale 1.15 in every trial.
model: on an airborne command with a press edge in IN_FORWARD|IN_BACK|IN_MOVELEFT|IN_MOVERIGHT (0x618): v = AirAccelerate(v) [M2]; t = time since the start of the jump command; lam = lam_max * clamp((t_zero - t) / (t_zero - t_full_end), 0, 1); d = normalize((1-lam)*vhat + lam*wishdir); D = |v|*d - v; if |D| > clamp_len: D *= clamp_len/|D|; v += D (horizontal only)

lam_max.unit: 1 (lerp weight between velocity direction and wish direction)
lam_max.source: [fit] direction of D on presses with t < 0.20 s, sideways (theta 88.4-89.4 deg), sprint 60/120/144 fps, walk, slide

clamp_len.source: [fit] |D| on every press whose speed dropped (clamped), any t, any condition incl. back
clamp_len.note: equals 0.7*299 = 0.7*260*1.15 and 182*1.15; movescale was 1.15 in every trial, so whether it scales with movescale or sprint speed is not determined

t_full_end.unit: s since the start of the jump command (curtime at press - curtime at jump)
t_full_end.source: [fit] linear fit of lam vs t over the 34 fade samples (0.001 < lam < 0.69998), intercept at lam_max

t_zero.unit: s since the start of the jump command

window_clock_offset.source: [obs] time offset implied by each fade sample under the rounded window (0.7 / 0.2 s / 0.5 s), relative to the summed HSD frametimes
window_clock_offset.note: sub-millisecond, sign differs by session: treated as clock/sampling uncertainty of the window edges (about +-1 ms), not as a frame-rate effect

order.value: AirAccelerate first, lurch second, same command
order.source: [fit] lurch-before-AirAccelerate gives 2.9-7.0 u/s max error on early presses vs 0.002 for the chosen order

commands_affected.source: [obs] max |v1 - AirAccelerate| on the other 9666 airborne commands of the 102 jumps = 0.033 u/s

model_error.unit: u/s, |v1_pred - v1_obs| on the press command, rounded parameters

dedi_parity.source: [obs] dedi MT identical within 0.002 on 101/102 press commands; r1033 (t = 0.492 s, lam 0.016) differs by 0.022 u/s (|D| 4.880 client vs 4.858 dedi, about 0.03 ms of clock); no client correction followed in any trial; no rp=1 replay covered a press command
